scripts.build: vite build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.build:cf: vite build && ADMIN_BASE=/ npm --prefix admin run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist-admin',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('admin/dist','dist-admin',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('src/assets','dist/src/assets',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('src/assets','dist-admin/src/assets',{recursive:true});"
